facts.fact_text: In April 2008, the DİSK (Devrimci İşçi Sendikaları Konfederasyonu – Confederation of Revolutionary Workers' Trade Unions) announced that it was planning a large-scale demonstration in Istanbul for 1 May 2008.

In April 2008, the KESK (Kamu Emekçileri Sendikaları Konfederasyonu – Confederation of Public Employees' Trade Unions) announced that it was planning a large-scale demonstration in Istanbul for 1 May 2008.
The DİSK and the KESK announced that their members would be gathering on 1 May 2008 to celebrate Labour Day.
The DİSK and the KESK announced that their members would be gathering on 1 May 2008 to commemorate friends who had lost their lives during the demonstrations of 1 May 1977.
The applicant explained that he had participated in a demonstration organised by his trade union on 1 May 2008 to celebrate International Labour Day.
